description: skill-guard: redirect noisy inline skills to subagents. worktree-guard: enforce exit-safety order on git worktree remove. skill-atlas-guard: block commits with stale skill-fleet evidence or any Skill & Doc Style finding. skill-path-fallback: deny a Bash command with an unexpanded ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and tell the model how to resolve the real script path. learn-capture (Stop) + session-replay (SessionStart): the [LEARN] sedimentation loop — capture markers into .claude/LEARNED.md, replay last 5 at session start. plan-anchor (SessionStart source=compact): replay the live plan's locked constraints (reference source / done-means / out-of-scope) that compaction drops. standby-watchdog (Stop): one nudge when a session parks itself narrating a wait while background work runs — notify the user instead of hanging silently. security-warning-relay (PostToolUse Agent): a subagent's SECURITY WARNING gets surfaced to the user, not read past. compact-audit (PostCompact): record which plan anchors each compaction summary dropped, into ~/.claude/observability/compaction.jsonl — no model call, substring checks only. obs-enqueue (Stop): append this session to ccobs' queue.jsonl for near-real-time ingest — one line, milliseconds, no model call. prompt-forge (UserPromptSubmit): experimental LLM-powered prompt enrichment — two-gate pipeline: short/confirmation inputs pass through, longer prompts classified by deepseek-v4-flash and enriched with repo/session context when fuzzy. Enabled by default; set PROMPT_FORGE=0 to disable; fail-open on any error. Progress surfaced via statusMessage spinner + stderr debug-log lines.
